Messages.Author: Metropolis
Messages.Body:
Just making sure, as I haven't seen Black Hand in the rulebook:

If I am Sabbat, and become Cardinal, I can then become Black Hand and then a
Seraph.

So I would be a Cardinal who was also a Black Hand Seraph. If I then got a
writ of acceptance, I would lose my ability to utilize the Cardinal Title,
although I would still be a Seraph.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Metropolis wrote:
> Just making sure, as I haven't seen Black Hand in the rulebook:

No need. As advertised, there are no new rules in BH.

>
> If I am Sabbat, and become Cardinal, I can then become Black Hand and then a
> Seraph.
>
> So I would be a Cardinal who was also a Black Hand Seraph. If I then got a
> writ of acceptance, I would lose my ability to utilize the Cardinal Title,
> although I would still be a Seraph.

If you used Blooding to become Black Hand and the Seraph card to become
Seraph, you'd loose the Seraphness whilst you're not Black Hand and you'd
lose the Black Handness whilst your not Sabbat (card text on Blooding
and Seraph).

If you're card text says "Black Hand Seraph:", then you'd remain Black
Hand and Seraph even whilst Camarilla.
